final_topology.title: High Availability Branch Office
final_topology.description: A branch office network with emphasis on high availability and voice service continuity, connecting to the central data center and supporting SIP-based voice traffic.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a primary connection to the central data center and a failover mechanism for voice services to the public phone network. It supports SIP-based voice traffic and includes centralized user authentication and network traffic logging.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n19) connected to the management zone (z4), which suggests the presence of an asset inventory system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links (e.g., nl5, nl6, nl7) and a SIEM (n6) for logging, which implies documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different types of data processing and storage (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6).

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a firewall (n3) and an application firewall (n17) in the branch office zone (z1).

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS server (n11) and DNS filtering service (n21) connected to the branch office zone (z1).

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA service (n20) connected to the security services zone (z6).

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS filtering service (n21) connected to the branch office zone (z1).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a URL filtering service (n22) connected to the branch office zone (z1).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different functions (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6) and various security controls (e.g., firewalls, IDS/IPS, MFA, DNS filtering, URL filtering).

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a bastion host (n14) and an identity server (n15) in the management zone (z4), suggesting secure management practices.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an AAA server (n15) in the management zone (z4).

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a VPN service (n23) connected to the security services zone (z6) and an AAA server (n15) in the management zone (z4).

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an IDS/IPS (n13) in the branch office zone (z1).

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a firewall (n3) and an application firewall (n17) in the branch office zone (z1), which suggests traffic filtering between segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an access control system (n24) in the security services zone (z6).

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM (n6) and flow logs being collected (nl15) from the firewall (n3).

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a non-production zone (z5) and a production zone (z1).

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a pen testing service (n25) in the security services zone (z6).
